name: Saint Barthélemy
groundLayout: Runway 09/27, with a Backtrack Area near the Rwy 27 end. Taxiway E runs alongside the runway's east side, from hold point C (mid-field) south through hold point B down to hold point A near the Rwy 09 end, serving Main Apron (Terminal, Control Tower, Ground Crew Station). Taxiway D connects General Aviation (Hangar, Fuel) on the west side to hold point D, also near the Rwy 09 end. Several hold points here are marked as hot spots on the chart (extra caution/confirm intentions, not special ATC phraseology) - real taxiway/hold-point letters are C, B, A, D, and E.
